step1_analysis.circuit_type: 8T SRAM / CAM cell (Extracted with shorted internal nodes)
step1_analysis.description: This netlist appears to be an extracted 8-transistor memory cell (likely part of a CAM or SRAM) where the internal cross-coupled nodes have been shorted together into a single node (N2) during extraction. It includes read and write wordline access transistors, but due to the shorted internal nodes, it acts as a static voltage divider.

paper_reference.title: A 1-V 128-kb Four-Way Set-Associative CMOS Cache Memory Using Wordline-Oriented Tag-Compare (WLOTC) Structure with the Content-Addressable-Memory

static_power.description: Static power consumption due to the shorted inverters

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on the short-circuit current of the diode-connected PMOS and NMOS transistors at N2.

v_n2.description: DC voltage of the shorted internal node N2

sky130_expected.calculation: Voltage divider between PMOS and NMOS: 50 * (1.8 - V_N2 - 0.42)^2 = 270 * (V_N2 - 0.42)^2 -> V_N2 = 0.71V
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the ratio of NMOS to PMOS drive strength.

read_delay.description: Delay from read wordline (R_WL) activation to bitline (R_BL_BAR) discharge

sky130_expected.calculation: I = 1.2 mA. dV/dt = I/C = 1.2mA / 10fF = 1.2e11 V/s. Time to drop 0.4V is ~3.3 ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Very fast discharge due to large W/L (5u/0.5u) and small load capacitance (10fF).

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure static power, N2 node voltage, and read delay of the extracted memory cell.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Extracted Memory Cell
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xmp0=5u L_xmp0=0.5u
.param W_xmn0=5u L_xmn0=0.5u
.param W_xmp1=5u L_xmp1=0.5u
.param W_xmn1=5u L_xmn1=0.5u
.param W_xmn3=5u L_xmn3=0.5u
.param W_xmn2=5u L_xmn2=0.5u
.param W_xmn5=5u L_xmn5=0.5u
.param W_xmn4=5u L_xmn4=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VW_WL W_WL 0 0
VR_WL R_WL 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1n 50p 50p 5n 10n)

* Precharge circuit for R_BL_BAR
MPRE R_BL_BAR PRE_EN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1u l=0.15u
VPRE_EN PRE_EN 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0.5n 50p 50p 10n 20n)
CBL R_BL_BAR 0 10f

* DUT
XMP0 N2 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp0} w={W_xmp0}
XMN0 N2 N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn0} w={W_xmn0}
XMP1 N2 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp1} w={W_xmp1}
XMN1 N2 N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn1} w={W_xmn1}
XMN3 N2 W_WL N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn3} w={W_xmn3}
XMN2 N2 W_WL N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn2} w={W_xmn2}
XMN5 R_BL_BAR R_WL N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn5} w={W_xmn5}
XMN4 N2 R_WL N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn4} w={W_xmn4}

.control
op
let static_power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
let v_n2 = v(N2)
print v_n2 static_power

tran 10p 10n
meas tran read_delay trig v(R_WL) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(R_BL_BAR) val=1.4 fall=1
quit
.endc
